sections.name: 🔑 Keywords Match
suggestions: Add these keywords: JavaScript, React, Node.js
Use exact terminology from job description
Keywords account for 35% of ATS score

sections.name: 📋 Format & Structure
suggestions: Use standard sections: Summary, Skills, Experience, Education, Projects
Avoid tables, images, and complex formatting

sections.name: 💼 Skills Optimization
issues: Skills section missing or not clearly labeled
suggestions: Categorize skills: Languages, Technologies, Tools, Frameworks

sections.name: 📊 Quantified Achievements
suggestions: Add metrics: "Improved API response time by 30%"
Include: Revenue, Users, Performance, Time saved

sections.name: 🎯 Job Title Matching
issues: Add relevant job titles in experience section
suggestions: Use titles like "Software Engineer", "Backend Developer", "Full-Stack Engineer"

sections.name: 🏗️ Project Relevance
issues: Projects section not found or not labeled
suggestions: Include tech stack for each project

sections.name: 📅 Dates & Experience
issues: Use consistent date format (e.g., Jan 2024 – Mar 2024)
suggestions: List experiences in reverse chronological order
